items.title: What Does Micron Technology (MU) Warning Of Shortages Through 2027 Mean?
items.summary: Micron Technology (NasdaqGS: MU) and Intel CEOs cautioned that memory chip shortages and higher prices could persist through 2027. Micron's leadership indicated on a recent call that supply constraints may only start to ease meaningfully from 2028 onward. Intel's CEO echoed the outlook for extended tightness in DRAM and NAND availability, pointing to heavy AI and data center demand. This warning from Micron and Intel about multi year memory shortages and rising prices is important context...

items.title: Q3 Earnings Season Preview: What Can Investors Expect?
items.summary: S&P 500 earnings in Q3 are expected to increase by +24% from the same period last year, reflecting the 8th consecutive quarter of double-digit earnings growth for the index. Earnings revisions have been positive, sustaining the favorable trend in place for almost a year now.
